fr.recommendations:
• Clear vegetation along walkways to maintain open paths for responders moving around the structure.
• Trim dense plantings near the main residence to keep the exterior walls visible and accessible from the parking areas.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street in both directions.
• Keep at least one parking area clear of vehicles to give responding units a staging location close to the structure.
• Identify and mark all access points to the property so responders can quickly locate entry routes on arrival.
• Thin dense vegetation between access points to allow responders to move around the building without obstruction.
• Post the property address visibly at each access point if more than one vehicle entrance exists from the street.
• Keep all walkways clear of stored items, equipment, or overgrowth so responders can move quickly between sides of the structure.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the clusters closest to the structures to create more open space between the trees and buildings.
• Remove shrubs that are growing directly against or immediately next to any structure.
• Trim low-hanging branches on trees near the structures so branches do not extend close to rooflines or walls.
• Clear any dead or dry plant material that has accumulated under tree clusters near the structures.
• Keep the areas between scattered trees and structures free of shrubs or low-growing plants that could carry fire from the trees to the buildings.
• Maintain open ground between the scattered shrubs and any structure walls or outbuildings.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and low vegetation that could block a vehicle.
• Remove any shrubs or small plants growing along driveway edges that could restrict vehicle movement or visibility.
